title: ARSENAL brand pack
description: A brand pack is tokens only: colour ROLES, type ROLES (vendored family + weight), texture, tempo, voice. Modules read roles, never hex. Optional: ramps (named OKLCH ramps derived by arsenal/patterns/palette) and weights (role weights for the seeded probabilistic sampler).

colour.description: #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA or rgb()/rgba() with 0-255 channels. Ramps and contrast checks need an opaque value; only `line` is expected to carry alpha.

family.description: CSS family exactly as vendor/fonts.lock.json spells it.

color.description: Colour roles. bg: the ground. ink: body and numerals on bg (>= 4.5:1). accent: the one live colour (>= 3:1 on bg). accent2: the second voice (the 'wrong' or 'other' colour). muted: secondary text and rules on bg (>= 3:1). line: hairlines (alpha allowed). panel: raised surface. chalk: highest-emphasis text ON panel (>= 4.5:1 on panel); same polarity as bg, so on a light pack chalk is darker than ink.

type.description: Type roles. disp: headlines and big numerals. mono: labels, ledger, digits. body: running text.

ease.description: Ease-out family used by this brand's moves.

beat_s.description: Seconds per beat; one move takes one beat.

ramps.description: Optional named ramps; each runs between two colour roles in OKLCH. When absent the palette pattern derives bgInk and accentBg.

weights.description: Optional role weights for the seeded probabilistic palette sampler (relative, any positive scale).
